csv_project_name: CI for Milepost 200 - Delaware River Bridge IQC
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Pennsylvania , Department of Transportation may be seeking a consultant to provide Construction Inspection for Milepost 200 - Delaware River Bridge IQC . The Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission will retain two (2) Engineering or Construction Management firms to provide construction inspection services on an open-end contract basis for various projects located within the Pennsylvania Turnpike s Eastern Region (Milepost 200.00 to the Delaware River Bridge and the Northeast Extension). The types of construction projects to be inspected under these agreements may include, but are not limited to, roadway repairs, asphalt overlays, bridge rehabilitations and replacements, facility modifications and other similar projects.
